master.notes:
The correct Ukrainian-language spelling of the album title is „Музика“. It was deliberately spelled with the Ukrainian letter І to emphasise the band's Ukrainian roots, since the album was VV's first release after their return from France in 1996.
The title track was one of the group's first songs, written in 1987 and performed at their early concerts.
